params.name: clipUuid
params.description: [UUID of the clip](https://developer.usertesting.com/v1.0/docs/how-to-obtain-uuids-for-api-requests#clip-uuids) you want to obtain information for.

items.docs:
Clip API allows you to build rich previews and embed clips containing meaningful insights in your solutions. 

The endpoint returns an embeddable video player link and metadata for a single clip.
